text:
Tage Thompson leads the league in wins added by his goals, first of 559 skaters, and The Athletic's Matthew Fairburn summed up his role: "He's been the Sabres' most consistent scorer and the guy dragging them into games." He has 17 goals and 28 points in 24 games, with goals in four straight (five in all), including two in the 6-2 win at Tampa Bay on Nov. 22.

The chances are real. He has 11.2 expected goals (the quality of his chances), his top shot of 100.17 mph sits at the very top of the league in NHL Edge tracking, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 93rd percentile for chances from in front of the net last season.

The finishing is where we hold back. He's shooting 18% against 15% last season, 5.8 goals ahead of his chances, and Buffalo has scored 8.4 more goals than expected with him on while taking only 51.5% of the expected goals at five on five. The Buffalo News has Jiri Kulich rediscovering his form beside him and Zach Benson. Watch the shot volume: 95 shots in 24 games is the part that's all his.
